notes: Source: Messer CV PDF (appears to date from ~2023; latest items are 2023, so 'forthcoming' items are assigned year 2023). Authors given as on the CV (initials, byline order). Skipped: commissioned NAS report, Choices magazine piece, teaching publications, grants. No working-paper section on the CV. Titles auto-extracted from CV text; hyphenation line breaks repaired. The Hohler et al. item is forthcoming on this CV but listed as published 2023 on Palm-Forster's newer CV, so treated as published. Venue names normalised for obvious typos (e.g. 'Economic Letters' -> Economics Letters).
